description: This file defines the ClientRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repositories to perform database operations related to Client entities, including custom queries to fetch clients by account number, client ID and hierarchy, and external ID.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing Client entities, with custom queries for fetching clients by account number, client ID and hierarchy, and external ID.

methods.name: getClientByAccountNumber
methods.description: Fetches a Client entity based on the provided account number.

methods.name: fetchByClientIdAndHierarchy
methods.description: Retrieves a Client entity by ID and hierarchy information, joining related office and transfer office entities.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Finds the ID of a Client entity based on an external identifier.
